A2.note: Game should always start at the root (/). There should be a config button with configure sound menu there. Sound Menu Voices uses the game music it should have a sample dialag (somthing like "Welcome to Blood Tower").

A3.note: Yes this works really good, however, Voice uses game music.

A4.note: Yes the level save great! However, from the story board there needs to be a menu button at all times. Sound Config should be here.

A5.note: Landing (I call root /) doens't have the flicker. However, story board does. The flicker is not random enough. the lights along the path are good, however the window is too fast and not random. I'm going for the feel of someone walking past the window causing the light to change.

B1.note: picking game is great! however, length and difficulty scroll the iPad when in portrait mode. Is the game designed for letter?

B2.note: lots of scrolling on phone but that is to be expected. On both iPad and iPhone it is hard to distinguish between option buttons and continue buttons.

C3.note: you need to get past Game settings first, but then you see "Not Ready"

F1.note: I don't like this step? Is this only from Proving Grounds?

H3.note: Pressed "Begin Play", Story board shows (full scree) the hallway. iPad should sections for the 4 hunters with "No private line" and a continue button. There is no such thing as Private lines.

I1.note: My monitor is 3840x2160 and at this resolution I can see the text, however in the "debug" window I do see the text. Need more explicit text like "Waiting on hunters"

I2.note: I did see the full screen Hall transition to the game play screen (which is very nice). The transition was too fast it needs to slow down. We need to work on this screen.

I3.note: I missed the text only because the text was hidden. The iPad alwas needs a back button in case the players missed something. This is a generic play mechanic for all stories

I5.note: the ambiant music stopped. The ambiant music should never stop expect maybe during dialog but then should start again

I6.note: There is never private moments in the game

I7.note: In the Story Board view under a new menu should be a Join options to display the QR code.

J1.note: There must be a confirmation to quit the game. I'm think something like you must hold the confirmation button for 5 seconds. The button fills during this time so the player is absoluetly sure they are quiting. I didn't see a summary board. From the Story Board menu shoudl be a Last game summary options and a Statistic view for previously played games

K1.note: the Table section (where QR is shown) show scroll bars

K3.note: Overall very nice. The game is really comming together
